reasoning_trace.value: The proposed system employs a microwave photonics-based full-duplex ISAC architecture, which separates signals using frequency division multiplexing (FDM). The system uses phase modulation for downlink transmission and intensity modulation for uplink transmission, enabling the reuse of the optical carrier over a single fiber for bidirectional transmission. This approach reduces system complexity and cost.
